name: wheel
title: Wheel
description: A value picked by turning a column until it rests under a mark.
use: A short, ordered set a reader knows by heart, picked by touch in the page: an hour and a minute, a unit, an interval. Scrolling and snapping are the platform's; the script reads which option rests under the mark and moves aria-selected to it.

instead.when: A keyboard and a pointer are the main input
The value is a number nudged up and down
A time in a form on a phone: a native time input opens the platform's own wheel

keyboard.action: Scroll the focused column until the option before or after rests under the mark, skipping disabled options
Scroll the focused column by a page: as many options as it shows
Scroll the focused column to its first or its last option

platform.fallback: Options are drawn flat, and the one marked aria-selected="true" takes the strong ink

classes.name: wheel
classes.description: The well and the mark across its middle, which its columns share

classes.name: wheel-sm
classes.description: Three 32px rows; the default is five 36px rows

classes.name: wheel-column
classes.description: A column that scrolls and snaps one option to its center, on a role="listbox" with a label and tabindex="0"

classes.name: wheel-option
classes.description: One value in a column, on a role="option"

classes.name: wheel-separator
classes.description: Fixed text between columns that rests on the mark: the colon of a time, a unit after a number

states.name: selected
states.description: The option under the mark, kept by the script; it takes the strong ink where view timelines are missing

states.name: disabled
states.description: Disabled ink, and no turn or fade

properties.name: --wheel-row
properties.description: Height of a row and of the mark; 2.75rem on touch screens

properties.name: --wheel-rows
properties.description: Rows in view; keep it odd

example:
Hour
Day
Week
Month
Year
